SELECT ticket.id AS ticket_id, ticket.status, ticket.used_at, event_seat.event_id, venue_section.name AS section_name, seat.row_label, seat.seat_label, buyer.email AS buyer_email FROM tickets ticket JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.id = ticket.event_seat_id JOIN seats seat ON seat.id = event_seat.seat_id JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.id = seat.section_id JOIN orders purchase_order ON purchase_order.id = ticket.order_id JOIN users buyer ON buyer.id = purchase_order.user_id WHERE ticket.ticket_code = #{code}
AND ticket.id = #{ticketId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tickets SET status = 'USED', used_at = #{usedAt}, checked_in_by = #{checkedInBy} WHERE id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ticket.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'USED')) AS valid, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ticket.status = 'USED') AS checked_in FROM tickets ticket JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.id = ticket.event_seat_id WHERE event_seat.event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT ticket.id AS ticket_id, venue_section.name AS section_name, seat.row_label, seat.seat_label, buyer.email AS buyer_email, ticket.used_at AS checked_in_at FROM tickets ticket JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.id = ticket.event_seat_id JOIN seats seat ON seat.id = event_seat.seat_id JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.id = seat.section_id JOIN orders purchase_order ON purchase_order.id = ticket.order_id JOIN users buyer ON buyer.id = purchase_order.user_id WHERE event_seat.event_id = #{eventId} AND ticket.status = 'USED' ORDER BY ticket.used_at DESC, ticket.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
